## Natural history notes

A small froghopper characterized by a dark brown to black body with two bright reddish-orange or yellowish bands across the wings. In Florida, the Two-lined Spittlebug is found in lawns, pastures, fields, roadsides, pine flatwoods, gardens, and other grassy habitats where turfgrasses and forage grasses are abundant. Nymphs feed near the base of grasses while hidden inside protective foamy “spittle” masses, while adults jump readily when disturbed and feed by piercing plant tissue, sometimes becoming pests of turfgrass and pasture grasses.
